findings.summary: Official and linked-vendor sources resolve the active Capitol Hill store at 526 8th St SE Ste A, phone 202-621-8645; the Dupont catalog was not merged.
No current comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact policy was found. Gluten-free roll/lettuce choices are presentation options, not proof of allergen-free preparation.
The official menu states that all standard subs use a 10-inch Italian roll. The baseline omitted wheat/gluten from most named subs despite extracting isolated filling allergens.

Farmer's Market After Dark is dairy-free in its standard current description; fresh mozzarella is an optional add-on. Crunchy Boi has current direct milk/egg/wheat positives but no current fish ingredient, so the baseline milk/fish pattern was not preserved.

The complete exact-location union contains 77 unique products across the official food menu, official catering menu, live Toast catalog, and two-item Diet Coke Happy Hour; merchandise/internal placeholders are excluded.

proposedChanges: Replace the 27-row partial SpotApps baseline with the complete 77-product current Capitol Hill union from official food, official catering, and exact linked Toast surfaces.
Retain all 27 frozen products as normalized current matches while separating catering packs/presentations from retail products.
Apply the official standard Italian-roll wheat/gluten scope to standard subs and keep optional mozzarella/cheese/sauce choices out of default contains claims.
Use only explicit current ingredient positives; do not infer blanket allergen-free or cross-contact status from gluten-free roll or no-bread options.
